artist.name: DJ MoCity
artist.bio: DJ MoCity was born in Baghdad and raised in New Delhi, and co-founded the online community radio station boxout.fm with Dualist Inquiry, where he hosts the show Motellacast. He also co-founded Reggae Rajahs, described as India's first reggae sound system, and the labels Dualism Records and 264 Records.

eras.sound: Hip-hop roots, R&B grooves and washy synths

press.title: Championing New Music With An Uncompromising Vision: Boxout.fm
